{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ahntanda slavery ring''' was run by [[Aubro Ahntanda]]. It was a cruel and violent group, and often captured victims from the patrons of the [[Ace of Sabres]] resort. [[Sibarra]] the Hutt was known to trick visitors into traps by offering them free recreation packages into the wilderness surrounding the Ace of Sabres and then selling them to the ring.<ref name="Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
